title: Safari Letter Ride
hook: Move the map before you move the rhyme.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D safari storybook, golden grass and blue sky, friendly wildlife, clean separated foreground subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child moving across a world wildlife map
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: map cue -> recall beat -> target -> point-to-region gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a dry shaker track-step followed by one low marimba note.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a dry shaker track-step followed by one low marimba note
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Safari Letter Ride as a global wildlife route: Africa, Asia, Australia, Americas, marine coasts and freshwater cards appear sequentially, with geography stated instead of putting every animal on one dusty savanna.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child moves a world map marker between regions; each animal gets a location/habitat clue before its body clue.
